Mobile deep linking

Button

Post-click routing / “post-tap” optimization
Button’s Dynamic Decisioning product uses AI to decide whether each tap should go to app, mobile web, or another path based on the likely conversion outcome. Button claims this can unlock 3–5x higher app revenue for retailers, though that is Button’s own marketing claim.
